data.name: Mediator's Ear
data.description: A Green Faith initiate is respected for her neutrality and even-handed attitude toward all people as well as other living things. She quickly develops some sense for others' attitudes, much as she does with animals. A Green Faith initiate gains a +%1 bonus on Diplomacy and Sense Motive checks.|floor(DruidLVL/2)
